title: Rio Bravo Invites Businesses and Families to Santa's Ranch Christmas Parade on Dec. 11
excerpt: Rio Bravo City Hall is inviting businesses, organizations and parade participants to its free Santa's Ranch Christmas Parade on Friday, Dec. 11, from 6:30 to 10 p.m. Sign-ups close Dec. 2.
content:
Rio Bravo City Hall is inviting businesses, organizations and parade participants to join its Santa's Ranch Christmas Parade on Friday, Dec. 11, 2026, from 6:30 to 10 p.m. The city announced the parade Tuesday, Nov. 17, on its official Facebook page.

Mayor Amanda Pérez Agüero, City Council members and city staff are inviting families to what the city calls a magical Western Christmas full of surprises. The city is also inviting groups taking part in the City of Laredo's Christmas parade to bring their floats and holiday spirit to both celebrations.

Participation in the Rio Bravo parade is free. Groups that want to take part must sign up by Wednesday, Dec. 2, 2026. To sign up, call Rio Bravo City Hall at (956) 790-9500 or send a message to the City of Rio Bravo Facebook page.

No parade route was listed in the city's announcement.

Source: Rio Bravo City Hall Official, Nov. 17, 2026.
